description.value:
You reach out with the Force to nudge the world around you. With careful control you can perform a simple manipulation at range — opening a latch, retrieving something from a container, or pouring out a liquid — without touching it.

Alternatively, you can violently shove or yank a Medium or smaller creature or object that isn't being worn or carried, provided you can see it. The target makes a Strength saving throw (an object automatically fails). On a failure, it is flung a distance based on its size: 20 feet for a Tiny target, 10 feet for a Small one, or 5 feet for a Medium one. If it collides with another creature or object at the end of that movement, both must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (an object automatically fails) or take 1d4 kinetic damage.

At 5th level the distances increase to 30/20/10 feet and the collision damage rises to 2d4; at 11th level the Small and Medium distances become 30 and 20 feet and the damage becomes 3d4; at 17th level a Medium target can be thrown the full 30 feet and the damage becomes 4d4.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, At-Will
